description: Update an existing text note's name, content, or metadata. New text replaces the existing text. A note that has not been analyzed yet is analyzed after the update; an already analyzed note is not re-analyzed, so call reanalyze_text afterwards if its insights should reflect the new text. Sends the media.updated event to the workspace's webhooks and Slack channels if any are configured.

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the text note

name.description: New name for the text note

text.description: New text content. Replaces the existing text of the note.

name: update_text_note

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
